spec.name: Reversal v38
spec.notes: High turnover by design: the reversal edge is measured net of 10 bps per unit of turnover.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 3.1, annual return 9%, maximum drawdown 3%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy uses a full sample backtest without out-of-sample validation, which is a significant concern. While the costs are explicitly modeled, the high turnover (implied by the reversal strategy and quantile portfolio) combined with a small maximum drawdown raises suspicion of a lucky period. The limited research log (only 2 trials) further reduces confidence. Paper trading is required to validate the results.
